## privacy policy

**Automatically Collected Information**

The “domain” and “IP” addresses of visitors to our website are automatically recorded. This information does not personally identify you; it only contains details about the computer used to access the site. Since this data indicates from where in the world and for what purposes the site is used, it is utilized in analyses to help us determine the scope of our website and better understand its purposes and usage patterns.

**Cookies**

If you wish to prevent cookie files from being stored on your computer, please adjust the necessary settings in your internet software. The cookie-type files we store on your computer will expire after a certain period of time. In some cases, blocking cookies may reduce the functionality of certain websites or prevent access to them. We store cookies on your computer in order to recognize you during future visits to our website. As this information includes details about your interests, it helps us guide you more easily within the site and enables you to find the information you are looking for more quickly.

**Data Collection and Use**

When you request information through this website, certain personal information about you is required. When you send us an email or subscribe to receive regular free information, we may need your email address, name, telephone number, and other personal identifying information. If you request services or products related to employment, we may require certain personal identifying information such as education, work history, family, and financial details. Your personal information will be used to provide the information, goods, products, and services you request.

**Disclosure and Visitor Preference**

You may unsubscribe or withdraw from the site at any time. Although we explain how your information may be used, if you wish to withdraw from the site, you may submit a request by sending an email or a letter.

**Security**

As Sharq Bahori, we have established security policies, rules, and the necessary technical systems in full compliance with all laws regarding the storage and protection of information, in order to ensure the security of all personal information under our control. Our security systems are designed to prevent unauthorized access, improper use and disclosure of information, unauthorized modification, unlawful destruction, or accidental loss.
